_note: Core textbooks, checked 2026-09-28 against publisher pages and Open Library by ISBN (SOURCES.md S29). Pointers only: no content is reproduced. Recheck editions yearly.

fundamentals.a: Lin T, Smith T, Pinnock C (eds)
fundamentals.why: The standard single-volume Primary text: clinical anaesthesia, physiology, pharmacology, physics and clinical measurement.

peck.t: Pharmacology for Anaesthesia and Intensive Care
peck.why: Principles of pharmacology, then drug by drug for anaesthesia and intensive care.

kam.t: Principles of Physiology for the Anaesthetist
kam.why: Physiology organised for anaesthetists, in short exam-sized chapters with applied physiology.

west.why: The classic short respiratory physiology text. A 12th edition is listed for January 2027.

cross.t: Physics, Pharmacology and Physiology for Anaesthetists: Key Concepts for the FRCA
cross.why: The graphs, definitions and equations examiners expect, each with a short explanation.

alshaikh.t: Essentials of Equipment in Anaesthesia, Critical Care and Perioperative Medicine
alshaikh.why: Equipment, how it works and its safety features.

davis.t: Basic Physics and Measurement in Anaesthesia
davis.why: Older but clear introduction to the physics and measurement principles.

magee.t: The Physics, Clinical Measurement and Equipment of Anaesthetic Practice for the FRCA
magee.why: Physics and measurement written around the FRCA.

ellis.why: The anatomy anaesthetists need, including regional and ultrasound anatomy.

yentis.t: Anaesthesia, Intensive Care and Perioperative Medicine A–Z
yentis.a: Yentis SM, Hirsch NP, Ip JK
yentis.why: An encyclopaedia: quick, reliable entries on almost any exam topic.

ohanaes.a: Freedman R, Herbert L, O'Donnell A, Ross N (eds); Allman KG, Wilson IH (consultant eds)
ohanaes.why: Pocket guide to clinical anaesthesia across every specialty; the Final's clinical backbone.

stoelting.why: Coexisting disease and its anaesthetic implications, system by system.
